There are 2 types of shuttle services available : Tohoku University Campus Bus (runs between TU campuses) Aobayama Shuttle Bus (departs from Aobayama station and stops at points around Aobayama campus) Please be advised that although the Aobayama Shuttle Bus can be used by students to commute between their homes and the university, researchers and faculty members are only allowed to use the bus to travel between campuses, and not to commute to the university from their place of residence. You want to say, “ Can I get a ticket to Cheongnyangni station (청량리) (청량리 가는 티켓 사고 싶어요) ” . The ticket should look like this (MAKE SURE THE NUMBER IS 6002 ) The station that you are getting off will be the last one. From there, you can either take Line 1 subway or take a taxi The taxi fee should be around KRW 7,000 and take about 10 minutes. If you still are having trouble with the bus, please click on this link. https://airportlimousine.co.kr/en/ Airport Pick-up service You can book an airport pickup through Enterance . The International Welcome Desk is responsible for coordinating the matching of pairs. When registering on the platform, each student can specify their expectations and preferences, and once the matching process is complete, the students are free to meet and begin the mentoring relationship. It is up to each pair to decide how they wish to work together. Register directly on the TANDEM platform The buddy system's objectives The objectives of TANDEM are: To facilitate the integration of international students by offering them personalised support from their peers upon arrival; To promote solidarity among students at Bordeaux Montaigne University by fostering mutual support; Encourage exchanges, enabling students at Bordeaux Montaigne University to enjoy an experience of openness and internationalisation within their own institution. The International Welcome Desk will be there to assist you at every step of the process. Furthermore, social and cultural events are organised throughout the academic year for students taking part in the TANDEM programme. Zurich, where the ZHAW School of Engineering also has a campus, is Switzer- land’s largest city and economic centre. Switzerland is a perfect starting point to explore Europe, by night train or by plane. Distances are short and famous cities are easily reached within a few hours. But there is also a lot to discover within Switzer- land: its diverse regions and four national languages, its mountains for hiking or skiing, its lakes and rivers for a swim or a boat tour, and many picturesque cities. ZHAW School of Engineering Founded in 1874 as the Technikum Winter- thur, the ZHAW School of Engineering has a longstanding tradition of educating engineers. Today, it still educates almost a quarter of all engineers in Switzerland. The ZHAW School of Engineering has very close links to companies in Switzer- land and abroad.
